notes.title: v1.1.7 Update
notes.content:
1. Added Daily Challenge mode.
2. Added MAC version.
3. UI size adjustment.
4. Game balance adjustment:
4-1. Alves's Meditation Enhance_ Fighting Spirit attack increases 20%.
4-2. Nicora_ default health increases to 50.
4-3. Normal difficulty, lower monster difficulty, rearrange some monster skills, remove some debuff skills.
4. Optimization and debugging.

notes.title: v1.0.28 Update
notes.content:
1.Fixed Nicora Skill "Thunderfall"_ The skill wrongly perform as only attack once.
2.Localization refine.
3.Fixed Achievement "No Mercy"_ players can't get the achievement when they fit the requirement.
4.Fixed event "Explore the Forest"_ The option "Counterattack" should deal damage to the Icecrown Deer.
5.Fixed Nicora Skill "Fiery Downpour" _ Animation shouldn't stuck when use this skill.
6.Hide Accessories "Soulfire Candle" and "Moldy Necklace"_ These two accessories have serious bug, and is too difficult to be fixed currently.
7.Fixed Debuff "Frost Protection"_ The buff deals too many layers.

notes.title: v1.0.27 update
notes.content:
Change: Difficulty balance adjustments, with a decrease in difficulty for the Normal, Hard, Thrilling, and Nightmare levels.
Change: Monster difficulty in parts of Story 2 and Story 3 has been lowered.
Add: New town dialogue events have been added to Story 3.
Add: Healing events have been added to the random event points in Story1 and Story2. (When the player's HP is below 40%, there is a 70% chance of triggering it once).
Fix: Language and text optimization has been improved to address certain option texts exceeding two lines, as well as adjusting certain accessory descriptions.
Fix: Skill adjustments and description errors have been corrected.
Fix: Special effects used by certain items have been fixed.
